about_the_game:
The immigrant ship heading to the Third Solar System has launched the "Gun Paradise" event.

Every citizen can participate in this event using their PC and earn PC hardware rewards.

This event is a third-person light Roguelike shooting game, where high numerical growth makes combat extremely thrilling,

while the rapid growth of enemies also brings immense pressure to the battlefield.

Each battle lasts 20 minutes, during which enemies automatically level up. The speed of enemy upgrades varies depending on the battlefield difficulty level.

Due to the significant growth in enemy stats, you need to quickly kill enemies to gain experience and level up, keeping your level and abilities ahead of the enemies.

Each time you level up, you receive a random MOD enhancement chip and one chance to select a MOD upgrade.

Each MOD upgrade can have up to three enhancement options. You can use the MOD enhancement chip to modify or improve these options.

Maximize your stat growth as much as possible. Balancing attack power and survivability is key to staying alive.

After completing the 20-minute battle, you enter the final Boss fight, where leveling up is no longer possible.This is the ultimate test of your ability growth.

During the battle, combat missions unlock sequentially, including [Treasure Hunt], [Pursuit], [Escort], [Defend the Portal], [Capture Resource Point],

[Hide], and [Assassination]. Completing these missions earns skill points to learn and upgrade skills, as well as gun materials,to upgrade and modify weapons in the shop.

You can develop new MOD attributes in the MOD shop, and these new attributes will appear in combat.

You can also choose whether to enable these MOD attributes, allowing some customization of your growth direction in battle.

Powerful enemies will periodically appear during combat. Defeating them grants computer components to strengthen your character, with a chance to obtain new weapons.

The higher the enemy’s level, the better the rewards.

DEMO Provides 1 level 60 combat area, 7 weapons, some weapons need to defeat strong enemies to obtain. 5 skills. mod development, weapon upgrade function, weapons can be upgraded to a maximum of 2 levels.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i3 10100 / AMD 3600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX580 / GTX 1060
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 10400 / AMD 5700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX5600 XT / GTX 2060
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: A tense 20-minute battle, using firearms and skills to eliminate enemies. Upgrade and select MODs to enhance yourself, complete various battlefield missions to learn skills, and obtain weapon materials. Maintain rapid growth in abilities to survive in the game.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
